title: Export your customers from Housecall Pro
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export your customers from Housecall Pro. You'll need to be an admin.
Select Customers in the left navigation bar.
Click Actions on the right side, then choose Export.
Confirm your email address, then click Send file.
The file comes from notifications at housecallpro dot com. If it hasn't arrived within an hour, check your spam folder.

capture.what: Demo mailbox: open the email, download the CSV.

scenes.narration: Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.
